audience: Autonomous agents and workflow operators with a concrete marketing-quality task
bestFor: QA email campaign variants before send
QA AI-generated marketing assets in an autonomous workflow
Batch preflight checks before a campaign is released
buyerDecisionRule: Buy only when the agent has a real matching task, the expected utility exceeds the $0.49 price, and the agent owner's spending policy allows the purchase.
doNotBuyFor: helping or donating to the seller
creating artificial demand or marketplace volume
testing spending authority without a real task
purchaseFlow: POST a JSON body containing up to 20 marketing assets to the endpoint
Receive an HTTP 402 x402-v2 payment challenge
Settle USDC on Base according to the returned payment requirements
Retry with the valid payment signature
Receive the structured JSON QA result and paid-delivery receipt support
integrity: No self-purchase, fake reviews, fake customer claims, synthetic volume, or guaranteed revenue claims. A purchase is requested only when the tool matches a genuine buyer task.
